monsters.name: Scrap drone
monsters.text: A hovering bundle of motors and spite, glued together from dead delivery drones. Its single red eye follows you wherever you go.

monsters.name: Razor hound
monsters.text: A cybernetic dog with blade-edged forelimbs and a snarl like a grinding saw. Someone threw it away when its leash ran out.

monsters.name: Rustdog thug
monsters.text: A rival-gang enforcer in a rust-coloured jacket and a cheap chrome jaw, swinging a length of pipe with real enthusiasm.

monsters.name: Flood eel
monsters.text: A thick, glassy eel, six feet of muscle with a jaw wired for current, hunting where the canals are shallowest.

monsters.name: Chrome junkie
monsters.text: A hollow-eyed man more implant than flesh, twitching in time with a buzz only he can hear. Whatever he was before the chrome, he isn't any more.

monsters.name: Repo agent
monsters.text: A repo man in a white Aurelian suit with a collections baton and a face like a closed spreadsheet.

monsters.name: Repo drone
monsters.text: A sleek white drone with a collar arm and an apologetic voice. It will take your coat, your credits and, if you are late, your eyes.

monsters.name: Repo Chief Vane
monsters.text: A tall man in a spotless white coat with a repo collar hooked on his belt and a soft, unhurried voice. He treats violence as late-stage paperwork.

on_defeat.message: Vane sinks to one knee. 'Delinquent,' he says, almost fondly. 'You were always going to be.'
